name: mc_verify
title: Exact build verification
description:
Opt-in exact verification: freezes a build's final eligible cells before placement, then checks the world against that expectation (missing or unexpected blocks, wrong materials or properties, supported sign text). Never places blocks.

WHEN TO USE: only when the user explicitly asks for exact block-state verification; not for ordinary builds by default, and not just because a build copies a photo. prepare BEFORE mc_build (it freezes keep/filter eligibility and managed sign values), check with the planId afterwards, then mc_repair with the fresh comparisonId.
WHEN NOT TO USE: preview images (mc_plan), inventories or NBT, revision history. Never evaluate a filtered build after placement and mistake skipped cells for success.

PARAMETERS: action prepare/check/list/delete. prepare takes build (mc_build's arguments; blueprints and transforms work). check takes planId, mode and limit (1-1000, default 100; counts are never truncated). mode exact (default) compares every canonical property; placement excludes derived connection properties for connected builds, never orientation or chest type. Coordinates are absolute.

SIDE EFFECTS: no world writes; reads may load chunks. Plans are owner-scoped, expire after two hours and are lost on plugin reload. Skipped or untouched cells, entities, rich sign styling and NBT are out of scope. Not an atomic lock; ids are stale after a newer check.

build.description: mc_build's arguments (same fields and rules; see mc_build), validated exactly as mc_build validates them.
